title: shelf config

loanDays.description: Loan length in days for `borrow`, and the default extension for `renew`.

maxLoanDays.description: Upper bound on how far in the future a due date may be set, in days.

dueSoonDays.description: Loans due within this many days are reported as `due-soon`.

allowAgentImports.description: Lets agents run `shelf add` / `shelf pull` from remote sources. Off by default: the library is the trust boundary, and only the user should widen it.

hooks.description: Install harness hooks (Claude Code, Codex) that renew loans when a skill is used and report loans needing attention at session start. Set by `shelf setup`.

mode.description: `copy`: a copy per target. `link`: one copy, other targets symlink to it.

targets.description: Project-relative directories that borrowed skills are written into.

description: shelf configuration (~/.shelf/config.json). Every key is optional.
